statements.statement: The procedure code billed is CPT 93271
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The symptoms are consistent with supraventricular tachycardia and sick sinus syndrome
The patient has a background of known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The monitoring study was ordered to capture arrhythmic episodes during daily activities
The service was ordered due to the intermittent nature of symptoms and the need to correlate clinical events with rhythm disturbances
Diagnosis code I47.1 applies to this patient
Diagnosis code I49.5 applies to this patient
The claim was denied with reason code CO-97
The denial reason is that payment for this service is bundled into another covered procedure
